name: From Making to Changemaking
description: By the end of the course, students will explore the role of design in driving systemic and meaningful change. Develop a changemaker mindset grounded in empathy, agency, and systems thinking. Prototype design-led interventions for scalable social impact in India. Reflect on their own journey as makers, learners, and potential changemakers.
